findings.issue: toggleRow/moveSelection/handleRowKeyDown row-selection keyboard nav copied near-verbatim into StorageTab.tsx (CardManifestTable). Same Enter/Space toggle + ArrowUp/ArrowDown focus-move logic in two place, no shared hook.
Duplicate of SearchTab keyboard nav logic (moveSelection/handleRowKeyDown) inside CardManifestTable. Should extract shared useRowSelection hook instead of two parallel implementation.
.search-row rule block (cursor, focus-visible outline, is-selected background) identical in structure to .storage-card-row block in StorageTab.css, only class name differ. Copy-paste CSS.
Same identical CSS pattern (cursor pointer, focus-visible outline, is-selected background) as SearchTab.css .search-row, just renamed selector.

Loading/error/loaded three-way branch repeated separately for price section and copies section with near-same shape (error null-check, then loading skeleton, then content). Could collapse into one render helper.

snapshotRow query for pricingSnapshots has no orderBy/limit, unlike the scanRows query just above it which explicitly does .orderBy(desc(scanRows.id)).limit(1). If pricingSnapshots stores a history of captures per tcgSkuId (name implies periodic snapshots, and it has a capturedAt column), .get() returns whatever row SQLite hands back first (typically oldest/lowest rowid), not the latest. Card detail panel would then silently show a stale price snapshot instead of the most recent one.
findings.fix: Add .orderBy(desc(pricingSnapshots.capturedAt)).limit(1) to the snapshotRow query, mirroring the pattern used for cardRow.

findings.issue: New feature (card detail panel, IPC handler, storage.service query) ships with no accompanying tests.
findings.fix: Add unit coverage for getCardDetail (especially snapshot selection) and a component test for CardDetailPanel loading/error states.

historical.message:
feat(card-detail): add reusable card detail side panel

New card:detail IPC channel returns card attributes from the newest scan
row, market price with scan fallback, the latest TCGplayer pricing
snapshot, and all non-removed physical copies for a SKU. CardDetailPanel
renders a non-modal 440px right-side panel (identity band, price block
with stale marker, copies list with highlighted origin, provenance
footer) with instant seed render, skeleton loading, inline retry,
Esc/arrow-key handling, focus return, and reduced-motion support.
Search and Storage rows open it; rows without a resolved SKU stay inert.

Constraint: read-only v1; status history, other printings, and Camera Scan wiring deferred to v2.
Rejected: modal with backdrop and full-screen takeover; glance flow needs the source list to stay visible and interactive.
Confidence: high
Scope-risk: narrow
Not-tested: no unit test infra for renderer; verified via typecheck, biome lint, and two reviewer passes.
